name: community-hero
title: Community hero
description: A community opening built from its members: a mosaic of faces, the member count, the channels busy right now and one join button.
docs: Pass twelve to eighteen members (name and an optional square image): the first half sit on the left of the text and the rest on the right, a phone shows eight, and a member without a picture is drawn as initials. Pictures load lazily, so the faces a phone hides are never fetched. total is the figure on the line under the button, channels are the ones busy now with how many are in each, and joinHref is where the button goes. The mosaic is decoration: a screen reader gets one sentence naming the first few members, and the labels prop translates it with the other fixed words. The faces flank the text when the container is at least 68rem wide and become a row above and below it otherwise, so the hero follows the width of its parent, not the window.
